block.description: Terraform provider for generating JSON documents with [CUE](https://cuelang.org/).

dir.description: Directory to use for CUE's evaluation. If omitted the current directory is used instead.

expr.description: Exrpession to lookup inside CUE value.

id.description: FNV-128a sum of the rendered emit value.

paths.description: List of paths to CUE instances to evaluate.

pkg.description: Name of the package to be loaded. If not set it needs to be uniquely defined in it's context.

rendered.description: Emit value rendered as JSON encoded string.

tags.description: List of boolean tags or key-value pairs injected as values into fields during loading.

unified.description: Unify multiple values into a single one. If false only the first value is emitted. (Default `true`)

block.description: The export data source evaluates a CUE definition and renders the emit value as JSON encoded string
